work_packages.validation: Exact restart cache HIT and meaningful identity MISS; foreign/tamper/truncate, cancellation/reselection/late callback/duplicate, interrupted durable publication/retry and independent sessions/reclaim.

payload.Shared Contract Handoff: CODE_REVIEW T01–T07 and exact per-element seam rows. CANDIDATE owns mod/source/selection identity; LAB actual normal preparation/producer coverage and metrics; ISSUER suite/profile/job/approval/cache authority; HOST normal apply and actor-generation transition; SAVE read-only required-config preflight and durable ownership. Product Sol owns concrete APIs/format/build/auth primitive, Root reviews public/authority/save/lifetime and adopts measured criteria. All new shared APIs are proposals until atomic node implements them; PUBLIC and VERIFY consume actual implementation. Test author owns separate files, entire shared product/test registration file changes are sequential.
payload.Known Unknown/Limitations: Real numerical thresholds/workload feasibility remain required measured GEX work, not a current-source gap. No uncalibrated qualifying profile, low-PC exemption, arbitrary cap/waiver or silent regression weakening. Schema/envelope/version and authentication/build details reviewed before affected edits; unknown source premise returns earliest owner. Independent author and sole executor separate; final auditor is nonparticipant. Impact-based validation and explicit reuse, not automatic full suites.
